name: Connected Papers
summary: Visual tool that builds graphs of academic papers related to a chosen paper.
description: Connected Papers creates a graph of papers related to a starting paper, so researchers can see prior and derivative works in a field. The free tier includes all features with five graphs per month; paid plans remove the monthly limit. Discounted or free premium access is offered to users who cannot pay. The tool is intended to give a quick overview of a field before a literature review. Group plans are available with annual or quarterly billing.
